name: ble.sh (Bash Line Editor)
description: Installs ble.sh for the remote user at ~/.local/share/blesh so interactive bash (via dotfiles) loads it. Pins a prebuilt ble.sh release tarball for reproducible, cached installs; falls back to build-from-source. Optionally installs a pinned fzf binary so ble.sh's fzf integration works.

version.description: ble.sh release version to install (matches the akinomyoga/ble.sh release tag without the leading 'v', e.g. 0.4.0-devel3). Used to fetch the prebuilt ble-<version>.tar.xz release asset.

installFzf.description: Also install a pinned fzf binary into the remote user's ~/.local/bin so ble.sh's fzf-completion / fzf-key-bindings integration works. Without fzf, ble emits '"fzf" not found' errors on every prompt.

fzfVersion.description: fzf release version to install when installFzf is true (junegunn/fzf release tag without the leading 'v').
